_meta.teaching_point: A functionally plausible auth change is blocked because test evidence is missing for staging. The gate fires on missing evidence, not on code quality.

change_package.title: Switch auth validation from session cookies to JWT tokens
change_package.diff_text:
--- a/src/auth/middleware.py
+++ b/src/auth/middleware.py
@@ -10,14 +10,20 @@
-import sessions
+import jwt
+JWT_SECRET = os.environ['JWT_SECRET']
+
-def validate_session(request):
-    token = request.cookies.get('session_token')
-    if not sessions.is_valid(token):
-        raise AuthError('Invalid session')
+def validate_jwt(request):
+    token = request.headers.get('Authorization', '').replace('Bearer ', '')
+    try:
+        payload = jwt.decode(token, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=['HS256'])
+    except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
+        raise AuthError('Invalid token')
change_package.author_summary: Switching from session-based to JWT-based auth to support the new mobile client. Session module will be deprecated in a follow-up PR.
change_package.rollback_plan: Revert PR and re-enable session auth middleware. No DB changes needed.
